content_sections.heading: OAV Mayurbhanj Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 5 vacancies are available - 1 for Warden, 1 for Head Cook, 2 for Assistant Cook and 1 for Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper.

content_sections.heading: OAV Mayurbhanj Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Warden (Male): B.A. / B.Sc. from a recognized university with at least two years of experience in hostel management. Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper (Male): HSC Examination from a recognized board. Head Cook (Male): Male for Boys' hostel. Assistant Cook (Male): Male for Boys' hostel.

content_sections.heading: OAV Mayurbhanj Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit

content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for OAV Mayurbhanj Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: . Fill the application form carefully with correct information. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the OAV Mayurbhanj Support Staff recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the OAV Mayurbhanj Support Staff recruitment is 15th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Support Staff posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 5 vacancies for Support Staff posts, including Warden, Head Cook, Assistant Cook, and Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required for the Chowkidar-cum-Sweeper post is HSC Examination from a recognized board.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Warden post?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Warden post is between 30 to 60 years. Retired teachers can apply up to 62 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Offline. Candidates need to send their filled application form through Speed Post or Registered Post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for an Assistant Cook?
faq.answer: The salary for an Assistant Cook is Rs 6,750/- per month, which includes the EPF share of both the employee and employer.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any preference given to local candidates?
faq.answer: Yes, preference will be given to local candidates during the selection process for these posts.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of Assistant Cook vacancies?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies available for the Assistant Cook post.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary for the Head Cook post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Head Cook post is Rs 9,000/- per month, including the EPF share of the employee and employer.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside the district apply for these posts?
faq.answer: No, candidates from outside the district are not eligible to apply for these posts.
